For my brother

Some people share our name. You share my story.

Through every ordinary day and every unforgettable chapter, having you as a brother has been one of life’s quiet blessings. Your strength, warmth, and faith leave their mark wherever you go.

Today, I celebrate not only the day you were born, but the man you continue to become. May the road ahead be full of purpose, beautiful surprises, and victories worthy of you.

With love, from your brother

May every chapter ahead carry light, purpose, and barakah.
